## Scratch: time-of-day encoding experiment
<!-- Exploratory only. Cyclical sin/cos encoding of time-of-day fitted against vehicle
counts with lm and randomForest. Not part of the Super Bowl analysis or any reported result. -->
```{r}
library(readr)
```

```{r}
traffic <- read_csv("traffic.csv")
```


```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
traffic2 <- traffic %>%
  separate(DateTime, into = c("date", "time"), sep = " ")

for (i in 1:nrow(traffic2)){
  if (is.na(traffic2$time[i])){
    traffic2$time[i] <- "00:00:00"
  }
}
```

```{r}
library(hms)
class(traffic2$time)
traffic2$time <- as_hms(traffic2$time)
traffic2$time_numeric <- as.numeric(traffic2$time)
traffic2$time_sin <- sin(2 * pi * traffic2$time_numeric / 86400)
traffic2$time_cos <- cos(2 * pi * traffic2$time_numeric / 86400)
X <- data.frame(time_numeric = traffic2$time_sin)
Y <- traffic2$Vehicles

lm_model <- lm(Vehicles ~ time_sin + time_cos, data = traffic2)

library(randomForest)
rf_model <- randomForest(Vehicles ~ time_sin + time_cos, data = traffic2)

library(caret)
#model <- train(
#  Y ~ .,
#  data = data.frame(Y,X),
#  method = "knn",
#  tuneLength = 14
#)
```

```{r}
test_pred <- as_hms("12:24:32")
test_pred_numeric <- as.numeric(test_pred)
test_obs <- data.frame(time_sin = sin(2 * pi * test_pred_numeric / 86400),
                       time_cos = cos(2 * pi * test_pred_numeric / 86400))

pred_lm <- predict(lm_model, newdata = test_obs)
pred_rf <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_obs)
pred_lm
pred_rf
```

```{r}
after_sb <- df[937776:nrow(df),]
```

```{r}
sb_speed_summary <- sb_week %>%
  group_by(time) %>%
  summarize(avg_speed = mean(`Avg Speed`,na.rm = TRUE))

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(sb_speed_summary, aes(x = as.character(time), y = avg_speed)) + 
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "Average Speed by Time of Day for Super Bowl Week",
       x = "Time (hour)",
       y = "Average Speed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
```

```{r}
subset8am_sb <- sb_friday[sb_friday$time == as_hms("08:00:00"),]
subset8am_regular <- regular_friday[regular_friday$time == as_hms("08:00:00"),]
eightam <- wilcox.test(subset8am_sb$`Avg Occupancy`, subset8am_regular$`Avg Occupancy`)
```

```{r}
z <- qnorm(eightam$p.value / 2, lower.tail = FALSE) * sign(eightam$statistic - (2791*5581/2))
r <- z / sqrt(5581 + 2791)
r
```

```{r}
(mean(subset8am_sb$`Avg Occupancy`) - mean(subset8am_regular$`Avg Occupancy`)) / mean(subset8am_regular$`Avg Occupancy`)
#median(subset8am_regular$`Avg Occupancy`)
```
